title: Flat base-change comparison for blow-ups
statement:
Let $g:Y\to X$ be a flat morphism of schemes [def-weil-flat-morphism] and let $\mathcal I\subseteq\mathcal O_X$ be a quasi-coherent ideal. Put $\mathcal J=\mathcal I\mathcal O_Y$ as in [def-nagata-extended-ideal], and use the sheaf Rees algebras of [def-nagata-sheaf-rees-algebra]. Let
$$
\beta_g:g^*\mathcal R_X(\mathcal I)\longrightarrow\mathcal R_Y(\mathcal J)
$$
be the canonical degreewise map of [def-nagata-flat-pullback-rees-map], regarded as a graded algebra equivalence using [lemma-nagata-flat-pullback-rees]. Its degree-zero map is the canonical identification $g^*\mathcal O_X\cong\mathcal O_Y$.

Write $P_T(\mathcal A)=\operatorname{Proj}_T(\mathcal A)$ for [def-nagata-relative-proj]. Use the chart-preserving identifications of the global blow-up [def-nagata-global-blowup] with $P_T(\mathcal R_T(\mathcal K))$: both are glued from the affine blow-ups $\operatorname{Proj}(\mathcal R_A(K))$ of [def-nagata-affine-blowup], with the same coefficientwise restriction maps. The identifications are the unique ones respecting these local models, supplied by [lemma-nagata-relative-proj-exists]. Define
$$
\operatorname{bc}_g:
\operatorname{Bl}_{\mathcal J}(Y)
\longrightarrow Y\times_X\operatorname{Bl}_{\mathcal I}(X)
$$
to be the composite
$$
\operatorname{Bl}_{\mathcal J}(Y)
\xrightarrow{\sim}P_Y(\mathcal R_Y(\mathcal J))
\xrightarrow{P_Y(\beta_g)}P_Y(g^*\mathcal R_X(\mathcal I))
\xrightarrow{c_g}Y\times_X P_X(\mathcal R_X(\mathcal I))
\xrightarrow{\sim}Y\times_X\operatorname{Bl}_{\mathcal I}(X).
$$
Here $P_Y(\beta_g)$ is the contravariant Proj map induced by the graded equivalence, and $c_g$ is the canonical flat base-change isomorphism; these are respectively clauses (2) and (4) of [prop-nagata-relative-proj-functoriality]. The products and the last induced map use [def-pc-fibre-product]. Thus the construction applies Proj to $\beta_g$ on affine opens and uses the compatible gluing in those cited interfaces. The displayed target puts $Y$ in the first fibre-product factor.

blueprint_notes.label: status
blueprint_notes.text:
**Status.** Bypassed by the formalized route: blow-ups are never
base-changed along a flat morphism. Every base-change step the route takes
goes through the universal property
`AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.IdealSheafData.exists_lift_blowup` and
the chart pullback squares
`AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.IdealSheafData.isPullback_blowup$\iota$`
instead.

blueprint_update.statement:
Let $g\colon Y\to X$ be flat and let
$\mathcal I\subseteq\mathcal O_X$ be a quasi-coherent ideal. With
$\mathcal I\mathcal O_Y$ defined in
[def-nagata-extended-ideal], define

$$
\operatorname{bc}_g\colon
\operatorname{Bl}_{\mathcal I\mathcal O_Y}(Y)
\longrightarrow
Y\times_X\operatorname{Bl}_{\mathcal I}(X)
$$

by applying relative Proj to $\beta_g$ on affine opens and gluing. The
degreewise graded equivalence used in this construction is
[lemma-nagata-flat-pullback-rees].

reviewed.note: mechanical checks by tools/merge_delivery.py; mathematics reviewed in full by NT-cc-Q135-211dc3d6a (reviewer sub-agent of L); spot-checked: I read the whole definition-only split, which has no new nodes, against main-20261015 def-nagata-blowup-flat-base-change-map (order 124), the blueprint proof of thm-nagata-blowup-flat-base-change and Stacks 0805/01O3/01OG/0804. The hypotheses are unchanged (flat g, quasi-coherent I) and so are the source and target (Bl_{IO_Y}(Y) to Y x_X Bl_I(X), Y first). The composite is Bl_J(Y) = P_Y(R_Y(J)), then P_Y(beta_g), then c_g, then Y x_X P_X(R_X(I)) = Y x_X Bl_I(X). Proj is contravariant and the arrow direction is right; clause (2) of prop-nagata-relative-proj-functoriality needs beta_g to be a graded equivalence, which lemma-nagata-flat-pullback-rees provides, and in degree 0 beta_g is g*O_X = O_Y. c_g is clause (4), flat case. The blow-up/relative-Proj identifications use lemma-nagata-relative-proj-exists: Gamma(V,R_X(I)) is the sum of the I_V^n on affine V, so the all-affine-opens gluing data of def-nagata-global-blowup match. This is an elementary unfolding (advisory: no node states Bl = Proj_X(Rees)). The last map is induced by def-pc-fibre-product and is defined because the identifications are compatible with the structure maps to X. All 11 stmt_deps exist and none is merged. There is no cycle (the item is not in its 127-node closure). The off-unit statements are in the cited unit sk-def-nagata-sketch-data, so no tool_uses are needed. LeanFinder, LeanSearch, Loogle and grep searches are all recorded and none matches. Edge cases checked: I=O_X gives the identity, I=0 gives the empty map, g=id gives the identity, and ideals that are not of finite type need nothing extra. The blueprint metadata is preserved.
